sloka: यद् उक्तवन्तो रामस्य भवन्तस् तन् मया श्रुतम् ।भवतश्चाप्यहम् वेद्मि युद्धे सत्यपराक्रमान् ॥६-३५-५॥।।
transliteration: yad uktavanto rāmasya bhavantas tan mayā śrutam ।bhavataścāpyaham vedmi yuddhe satyaparākramān ॥6-35-5॥।।

translations.english: "Even though you are truly valorous in war, on knowing Rama's prowess, you are standing mute looking at each other. I know that."
